follow-up time: Up to 16 years (from first birth to end of study period)
outcome: Blood transfusion within 30 days of hysterectomy
cohort: 7685 women in Denmark who gave birth for the first time between 1993 and 2012 and underwent a benign, nongravid hysterectomy between 1996 and 2012.
finding: Women with a history of cesarean delivery have an increased risk of reoperation, perioperative complications, postoperative complications, and blood transfusion when undergoing a hysterectomy later in life.
mod_finding: This study investigated the long-term risks of complications after cesarean delivery compared to vaginal delivery in women undergoing hysterectomy later in life.
